2.15.3 Subreport.ActionInfo
The Subreport.ActionInfo element is ignored.
The following is the XML Schema definition of the Subreport.ActionInfo element.
 <xsd:element name="ActionInfo" type="ActionInfoType" minOccurs="0" />
In RDL 2003/10 and RDL 2005/01, the equivalent element of Subreport.ActionInfo is
Subreport.Action, which is of type Action.
